description: Erection of a single storey rear and side infill extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (049-101-AL.dwg (existing ground floor), 049-101-AL.dwg(existing front &rear garden), 049-102-AL.dwg, 049-103-AL.dwg, 049-111-AL.dwg, 049-120-AL.dwg (existing section a-a), 049-120-AL.dwg (existing section a-a gardens), 049-141PA-AL.dwg (proposed ground floor), 049-141PA-AL.dwg (proposed front & rear garden), 049-142PA-AL.dwg, 049-151PA-AL.dwg, 049-160PA-AL.dwg(proposed section a-a), 049-160PA-AL.dwg (proposed section a-a gardens), site plan and block plan- 19/10/2021
shadow analysis and 049 -141FSP-AL.dwg- received 19/11/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
